description: Dispatch a task to a conversation. **Give a goal, not commands**: DSH decides which file, shell, search, skill, subagent and team tools to use, and this server does not preload or proxy DSH's tool surface. **Non-blocking by default (wait=false)**: it returns run_id + sentinel_file at once, the turn runs in the background and you are notified when it ends, so you can do other work and the task is never cut off by a timeout. Pass wait=true to block for the result (optionally with timeout_ms; on expiry it only moves to the background and does not cancel the turn). [A timeout never destroys the task] when wait=true reaches timeout_ms before the turn ends, this tool **does not error and does not cancel**: it downgrades to background, returns run_id + sentinel_file, and the turn runs to the end with the result delivered through the sentinel file (timeout_ms=0 means wait forever). In both modes a small file holding the final result is written atomically when the turn ends. **Wait for it with a background task (Bash run_in_background + `until [ -f sentinel_file ]`; on Windows/PowerShell a `Test-Path` loop, and the receipt contains ready-made commands) and you are woken when it lands; no polling needed.** Once the file exists, read it for the result, or collect with dsh_get(conversation_id, run_id); dsh_read shows output while the turn is running. Reasoning is hidden by default (answer plus reasoning statistics only). Results and background receipts carry a `review` ticket (advisory by default): verify, then submit a verdict with dsh_review. If the conversation is busy this tool errors: use dsh_send(queue=true) to enqueue (returns at once), dsh_interject to stop and redirect, or dsh_interrupt to just stop.

client_run_id.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (up to 128 characters, scoped to this conversation). Submitting the same key again does not create a second run: it returns the first run's result or receipt (replayed=true). For safely resending after a response was lost in transport.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.

prompt.description: The task. It may refer to file paths in the workspace.

queue.description: Whether to enqueue when the conversation is busy (default false = error). With true it returns run_id + queue_position at once and runs after the current turn; the sentinel is written only when the run really ends, not when it is queued. The queue is memory-only and lost on restart; manage it with dsh_queue. (dsh_interject(mode='queue') also runs after the current turn, but it blocks until the new turn ends and does not use this queue.)

reasoning.description: How much reasoning to return. Default hide (answer only, reasoning as statistics). full uses a lot of context.

review.description: Review policy for this dispatch, overriding the conversation default (advisory). advisory: the result and sentinel carry a review ticket asking the caller to verify independently and submit a verdict with dsh_review; off: none this time.

team.description: Whether to prepend the "form a team first when this needs parallel or multi-role work" hint to this dispatch (default follows DSH_MCP_TEAM). false turns it off for this call only; DSH_MCP_TEAM=0 turns it off entirely.

timeout_ms.description: Upper bound on the **wait**, in milliseconds, only with wait=true. **Default 0 = wait forever** (no invented 30-minute limit). On expiry the turn is not cancelled; it moves to the background and you get a run_id.

wait.description: **Default false**: return run_id + sentinel_file at once; the turn runs in the background and the sentinel file signals completion (recommended). true = block until the turn ends and return the full result.

name: dsh_send
title: Dispatch task
